extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, stakeholders, companies, and legal representatives seeking to submit comments, citizen petitions, or other filings to the FDA dockets
extracted.subtask_short: submit comments and petitions to FDA
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for submitting new filings and comments to FDA dockets, distinguishing which submission types must use the FDA Electronic Method versus those that must be submitted to topic-specific dockets (e.g., via Regulations.gov) or mailed. Includes examples, mailing address, and links to Regulations.gov/FDMS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission type classification (New Submissions vs Previously Established Dockets)
rubrics_metrics.description: The FDA receives two types of submissions: New Submissions for FDA Action and Submissions to Previously Established Dockets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this classification to determine the correct filing pathway and method: the page enumerates separate instructions for new submissions intended for FDA action versus submissions that relate to already-established dockets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use FDA Electronic Method for Specific Electronic Submissions (new submissions)
rubrics_metrics.description: For New Submissions for FDA Action, please use the Food and Drug Administration’s FDA Electronic Method for Specific Electronic Submissions docket for the following: Citizen Petitions; Device Reclassification; Stay of Action Request; External Guidances; Food and Color Additives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These specific submission types should be filed via the FDA Electronic Method for Specific Electronic Submissions docket rather than as comments to an existing Regulations.gov docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submissions encouraged but physical delivery accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: While the FDA encourages submission of this information electronically, the agency continues to receive submissions via USPS, UPS, and FedEx delivery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitters may still send materials by mail/courier if they cannot use electronic methods; electronic submission is preferred but not mandatory for the listed submission types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments to previously established dockets must use topic-specific docket ID via Regulations.gov or be mailed
rubrics_metrics.description: The FDA’s Electronic Method for Specific Electronic Submissions cannot accept comments. Comments must be submitted directly to the topic-specific docket ID (FDA-20XX-X-XXXX) that is open for commenting via Regulations.gov, or mailed directly to the FDA’s Dockets Management, 5630 Fishers Lane, Rm. 1061, Rockville MD 20852.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When commenting on an existing docket, always reference the correct docket ID (format FDA-20XX-X-XXXX) and use the open Regulations.gov comment interface or mail to the specified Dockets Management address. Do not attempt to submit such comments through the FDA Electronic Method docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket ID requirement for commenting
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments must be submitted directly to the topic-specific docket ID (FDA-20XX-X-XXXX) that is open for commenting via Regulations.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure your comment cites the correct docket ID so it is associated with the right rulemaking or administrative proceeding; the page gives the docket ID format as an example.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples of submissions appropriate for previously established dockets
rubrics_metrics.description: Some examples of submissions to previously established dockets include citizen petition amendments or withdrawals, comments to specific action, or a supplement to a reclassification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these examples to decide whether your filing is a new submission for FDA action (use the FDA Electronic Method) or an addition/comment to an existing docket (use Regulations.gov or mail).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dockets Management/FDMS as the official repository
rubrics_metrics.description: The FDA's Dockets Management system serves as the official repository for the administrative proceedings and rulemaking documents for the FDA. Dockets Management is administered by the Federal Dockets Management System (FDMS), located at Regulations.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Records (Federal Register documents, petitions, supporting documents, and comments) are stored in FDMS/Regulations.gov; submitters should expect their filings and comments to be accessible there and to follow FDMS/Regulations.gov procedures for public access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulations.gov as the vehicle for submitting comments electronically
rubrics_metrics.description: Regulations.gov also serves as a vehicle for making your voice heard at the FDA by providing the ability to submit comments electronically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a docket is open for comment, use Regulations.gov’s interface to file comments electronically; see linked resources such as 'How to Use Regulations.gov' for procedural help.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related resources and links for filing and guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Related Links: FDA Memoranda of Understanding; Posting of Comments; Freedom of Information; Historical Dockets Information; Tools and Resources; Regulations.gov; How to Use Regulations.gov; Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (GPO); Comment on Proposed Regulations and Submit Petitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult these resources for additional procedural details, FOIA queries, historical docket data, and step-by-step instructions on using Regulations.gov and other electronic resources.
